notes: Deterministic v2 engine rules. All scores are unitless [0,1] unless units say otherwise; all *_days outputs are calendar days >= 0. Missing inputs use the documented default and never crash. Every nonzero adjustment is appended to explanation_json.adjustments with feature, value, adjustment, reason.

rules.name: historical distribution baseline
rules.formula: use provided quantiles after monotonic repair
rules.missing_data: falls back to requirement baseline; baseline_source recorded in explanation_json

rules.name: requirement-derived baseline
rules.formula: p50 = max(procurement+production+logistics stage days, supplier_stated_lead_time_days, 1.0); p80 = p50*1.18; p90 = p50*1.35; production = ceil(quantity / (capacity*0.85)) + 2; transit from destination lookup tables (sea 14-28d, air 2-4d)
rules.defaults: capacity 500/day; unknown destination sea=20d air=4d; material 17d qc 6d logistics 10+transit

rules.name: requirement confirmation days
rules.formula: 3.0 * (1 - completeness)
rules.missing_data: default applied silently (component visible in breakdown)

rules.name: supplier response delay buffer
rules.formula: tiers: <1.2 -> +0d; [1.2,2.0) -> +1d, sigma+0.03; [2.0,3.0) -> +2d, sigma+0.07, +1 risk point; >=3.0 -> +min(5,max(3,ceil(ratio)))d, sigma+0.12, +2 risk points, fallback_supplier_required

rules.name: business-hours delay buffer
rules.formula: [1.5,3.0) -> +1d; >=3.0 -> +2d + manual_review_required

rules.name: lead-time revision buffer
rules.formula: 1 -> +1d; >=2 -> +3d, +1 risk, manual_review_required

rules.name: upstream confirmation signal buffer
rules.formula: [0.3,0.7) -> +2d; >=0.7 -> +3d, fallback_supplier_required, +1 risk

rules.name: supplier load buffer
rules.formula: [0.5,0.8) -> +1d; >=0.8 -> +3d, +1 risk, fallback_supplier_required. Capacity-queue risk: 0 below 0.70 utilization, linear to 1.0 at 0.90, then 1.0; queue days = 4*risk/priority_factor

rules.name: buyer requirement volatility buffer
rules.formula: 1 change -> +2d; >=2 -> +min(7, 3+count)d, +1 risk. Factor path: volatility*4d into buyer decision buffer

rules.name: buyer decision delay buffer
rules.formula: [0.3,0.7) -> +2d; >=0.7 -> +5d, +1 risk. Factor path adds score*5d

rules.name: historical quoted-vs-actual error buffer
rules.formula: error > 5d -> +min(5, error*0.4)d uncertainty, +1 risk

rules.name: material procurement days + material risk
rules.formula: days by status: in_stock 0; reserved 1; partial max(1, est*(1-coverage)); confirmation_required est(7); substitute 3+est; not_available max(10, est(12)); unknown 10*(1+uncertainty). risk = 0.25*status_risk + 0.20*(1-confidence) + 0.20*confirm_prob + 0.15*uncertainty + 0.10*substitute + 0.10*hist_delay, clipped [0,1]
rules.defaults: status unknown -> risk 0.70 path; confidence default 0.35

rules.name: production days (factor path)
rules.formula: effective_capacity = nominal * max(1-utilization, 0.15) * yield * priority / complexity_multiplier; production = setup + ceil(quantity/max(capacity,1)) + subprocess; complexity multiplier in [1,2]

rules.name: QC days
rules.formula: max(baseline_qc, 2.0 + 3.0*qc_intensity)

rules.name: logistics chain days
inputs: logistics_trade.{export_doc_readiness_score, origin_inland_days, departure_frequency_days, freight_space_risk, route_baseline_days, import_clearance_days, destination_inland_days}
rules.formula: export_prep = 1 + 2*(1-doc_readiness); departure_wait = freq/2 + freight_space_risk*freq; main_freight = route_baseline | destination lookup; logistics_buffer = max(baseline, sum(chain))

rules.name: risk buffer / uncertainty inflation
rules.formula: uncertainty_buffer = 4 + 10*lead_time_uncertainty_risk (factor path); risk_buffer += 6*uncertainty_risk; delta_sigma>0 -> risk_buffer += delta_sigma*10; composition: p80 += 0.8*uncertainty, p90 += 1.2*uncertainty (additive path) or spread*(1+0.8r)/(1+1.3r) (factor path)

rules.name: quantile composition + monotonic repair
rules.formula: factor path: trade_processing_spread; historical path: pseudo-lognormal (mu/sigma from p50,p90; sigma clipped [0.05,0.85]); else additive. Always: p50=max(p50,0); p80=max(p80,p50); p90=max(p90,p80)

rules.name: fallback supplier recommendation
inputs: risk points/flags from delay, upstream, load, trader-mode, uncertainty risk
rules.formula: required if any triggering rule fired OR deadline_risk_level in {medium_high, high} OR lead_time_uncertainty_risk >= 0.65. GLTG only recommends; supplier IDs are never invented — candidates must come from the caller/GPM

rules.name: deadline feasibility
rules.formula: feasible = selected_confidence_days <= deadline; risk level: selected<=deadline -> low/medium (by risk points); p50<=deadline<selected -> medium_high; else high
rules.defaults: no deadline -> feasible=null, level from risk points

rules.name: confidence score
rules.formula: clip(supplier_conf(0.7) + 0.08*[sample>=30] - min(0.25, (p90-p50)/p50*0.2) - min(0.25, risk_points*0.06), 0, 1)

rules.name: manual review trigger
rules.formula: any trigger sets manual_review_required; policy 'required_if_deadline_tight' also sets it for medium_high/high deadline risk. Each trigger has a warning code (explainable)

rules.name: response delay reason inference
rules.formula: softmax over 8 reason scores (weights in simulator); provided reason short-circuits with confidence 1.0
